sources.title: UC Berkeley Housing — Unit 3
sources.notes: Verified live 2026-08-10. The current page publishes the canonical Unit 3 double text and 3D views: centered inward-swinging door opposite a centered window, a closet/mirror/light for each student beside the entry, one bookshelf and Twin XL on each side wall, and two study desks aligned in the center for access from opposite student sides. It states no numeric dimensions and warns that rooms vary.

sources.title: UC Berkeley Housing — Unit 3 double published 3D floor plan
sources.notes: Official floor-plan image linked from the live Unit 3 page, verified 2026-08-10. The companion entrance view is https://housing.berkeley.edu/wp-content/uploads/double_side_01-250px.jpg. Together they define this record's canonical published-3D variant; they do not provide numeric measurements.

sources.title: UCBStudentAffairs — UC Berkeley Housing Mini Tour: Unit 3, Double Room
sources.notes: Official Unit 3 tour published 2020-04-23 and still linked from Berkeley Housing's tours page on 2026-08-10. It shows a valid alternate example with the two desks side-by-side at the window. That tour layout is documented as a variation and is not blended into the canonical published-3D floor plan.

sources.title: UCBStudentAffairs — Sample UC Berkeley High-Rise Double Room
sources.notes: Official unoccupied UC Berkeley high-rise double used only as a physical-furniture and material analog for the published Unit 3 double render. It shows light natural-wood beds, desks, drawer units, and chairs; dark carpet; white built-in storage; and the closet-area mirror/light arrangement. It is not Unit-3-specific and does not establish this record's layout or dimensions.

sources.title: Unit 3 double two-bay window visualization analysis
sources.notes: Internal 2026-08-10 proportional interpretation of Berkeley's published double render plus the official high-rise analog. The 2.4 m width models the full two-bay assembly as two approximately 1.2 m bays; the 1.6 m height is a visual proportion estimate. Neither number is published or measured by Berkeley, and the older pack's single-opening recommendation does not establish this assembly size.

public_notes: Representative model only; exact room dimensions are not verified. The 4.115 × 3.505 × 2.44 m visualization shell is an estimate, while room_shell remains unknown.

Canonical layout follows Berkeley's published Unit 3 double 3D example: centered door and window, entry-side closets/mirrors/lights, one bed and bookshelf per side wall, and tandem center desks accessed from opposite sides.
The official 2020 Unit 3 double tour shows a different valid window-desk arrangement; it is documented as a variation and not blended into the canonical plan.

Furniture existence was rechecked against the official UC Berkeley Housing Unit 3 page on 2026-08-10. Dresser and Microchill poses are representative visualization assumptions because the canonical description does not locate them clearly.
Bathrooms are community bathrooms located on each floor, not inside the room.
Rooms vary in size, layout, and furniture configuration (official UC Berkeley Housing warning).
internal_notes: Unit 3 double evidence was re-researched and reconciled on 2026-08-10; the published 3D example is the canonical variant.
visualization_shell dimensions are sourced modeling estimates, not verified Berkeley measurements.
The official gallery photo labeled 'A Triple Room in Units 1-3' is excluded from double-specific layout, furniture-profile, and material claims.
